_about: Hand-written stand-ins for model replies, used by step3_agent1.py --llm fake. CS3200's first reply has one paraphrased quote on purpose, so the evidence check and the retry loop get exercised. These are not model output, and numbers computed from them say nothing about a model.

outcomes.outcome: Design normalized relational schemas that handle a business problem's edge cases
outcomes.evidence: produce a normalized schema that handles edge cases

outcomes.outcome: Write complex SQL queries using joins, subqueries, and window functions
outcomes.evidence: master SQL - not just SELECT statements, but complex joins, subqueries, window functions

outcomes.outcome: Use indexing and query plans to improve query performance
outcomes.evidence: performance optimization through indexing and query plans

outcomes.outcome: Explain how transactions and ACID properties keep data correct when systems fail
outcomes.evidence: Transaction management and ACID properties are covered extensively

outcomes.outcome: Evaluate when a document store like MongoDB is the right choice
outcomes.evidence: work with document stores (MongoDB) and understand when NoSQL is the right choice

outcomes.outcome: Apply database administration basics such as backups and user permissions
outcomes.evidence: be comfortable with basic database administration

outcomes.outcome: Describe non-relational approaches to storing data
outcomes.evidence: We'll spend the last third of the semester on non-relational approaches
